name: A Bundle of Hides

narrative.details:
I have a bundle of hides from the animals of the Barrens, and must get them to Thunder Bluff.  A colleague there, Ahanu, will use the hides to create leather goods.

Will you take the hides to him for me?

The quickest way to Thunder Bluff is on the back of a wind rider.  Bring the bundle of hides to Devrak, our wind rider master in the Crossroads, and speak to him about transport to Thunder Bluff.
narrative.objectives: Bring the Bundle of Hides to the wind rider master Devrak in the Crossroads.
narrative.offerRewardText: If you must take these hides to Thunder Bluff, then you are speaking to the right orc!
narrative.requestItemsText: Are you here for a wind rider? You have something to transport?

chain.subtitle: 4 quests at level 10, 1,890 XP in all.

quests.name: A Bundle of Hides
quests.objectiveText: Bring the Bundle of Hides to the wind rider master Devrak in the Crossroads.

quests.name: Ride to Thunder Bluff
quests.objectiveText: Buy a wind rider to Thunder Bluff from the wind rider master Devrak, then bring the Bundle of Hides to Ahanu in Thunder Bluff.

quests.name: Tal the Wind Rider Master
quests.objectiveText: Bring Ahanu's Leather Goods to Tal in Thunder Bluff.

quests.name: Return to Jahan
quests.objectiveText: Buy a wind rider to the Crossroads from the wind rider master Tal, then bring Ahanu's Leather Goods to Jahan Hawkwing.
